argument_macro_structure.dominant_argument_form: The text is a philosophical argumentative essay that critiques the Direct Argument for incompatibilism by exposing a counterexample to its central transfer principle, then showing that the defense of that principle collapses into an indirect, PAP-dependent argument.

dialectical_engagement.objection_handling: The text anticipates incompatibilist objections and attempts to neutralize them by showing that each defense either assumes what it needs to prove or forces reliance on PAP.

summary_of_core_decisions: The text argues that the Direct Argument for incompatibilism fails because its transfer principle (NR1) is invalid, as shown by the Bob counterexample. Any attempt to repair NR1 forces the incompatibilist to rely on the Principle of Alternate Possibilities, thereby collapsing the Direct Argument into an indirect argument and exposing it to traditional control-based objections.
